title: Google’s Gemini 3.6 Flash targets enterprise agent token costs

thread_text:
1. Your AI bills are leaking

Every enterprise agent call burns compute on tokens that don't matter. Each query costs you money before it even starts thinking.

2. How it works

Gemini 3.6 Flash prunes unneeded context before processing a single query. No extra steps, no code changes from you.

3. The real number

Your agent bills drop 40% with just a provider switch. No retraining, no rewriting prompts.

4. The catch

Most teams don't know their token waste ratio. They benchmark against nothing and keep paying for silence.

5. Test it today

Run a prompt through your current provider and count the wasted tokens. Does 40% savings sound worth a 15-minute benchmark?
